newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish F-16 warplane crashes in western Turkey.
newsitem.headline: Turkish F-16 warplane crashes in western Turkey.

text.p: A Turkish F-16 warplane crashed on a training flight in western Turkey on Friday and the pilot parachuted to safety, military headquarters said.
It said in a statement the plane crashed in Kutahya province at 12.20 p.m. (0920 GMT) after taking off from a military airport in nearby Eskisehir.
The pilot was safe after ejecting clear of the aircraft, which crashed in an uninhabited area.
An investigation into the cause of the crash was continuing.
